description: Rule of 72 Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How long until my money doubles? The rule of 72 is a quick guess: 72 ÷ the yearly rate is about how many years it takes to double. It divides 72 by the yearly rate for a quick guess. Then it shows the exact time to double at that rate. It does not say what rate your money will earn. People ask for it as "rule of 72", "rule of 72 calculator" or "how long to double money".

amount.description: Money you start with. US dollars. This only changes the chart. Default: 1000.

rate.description: Yearly rate. A percent: 5 means 5%. Like the rate on savings or a loan. Default: 4.
